governing_standard: W33 Golden Learning & Assessment Standard v1.0

findings.title: Audio Generator Fragmentation & Stale Generation Task Defect
findings.root_cause: tools/generate_w33_all_audio.mjs contains obsolete single-voice listening tasks with incorrect text (e.g. orange warning sign in P5 inst1, paragraph summary in P2 full). Running generate_w33_all_audio.mjs would overwrite the multi-voice audio produced by regenerate_w33_listening_audio.mjs with stale content.
findings.impact: Accidental invocation of tools/generate_w33_all_audio.mjs destroys Cambridge multi-voice compliance and introduces stale spoken text.
findings.required_fix: Deprecate/consolidate tools/generate_w33_all_audio.mjs into a single authoritative universal pipeline referencing 100% hub source data.

findings.title: Manifest Rebuild Decoupled from Validator Execution Gate
findings.root_cause: npm run audit:audio:semantic executes whisper_audio_semantic_validator.mjs directly without forcing build_w33_audio_manifest.mjs first.
findings.impact: If source content in listening_hub.js changes, running audit:audio:semantic alone validates against stale manifest on disk rather than live source code.
findings.required_fix: Prepend manifest rebuild or assert source-manifest hash identity at the start of whisper_audio_semantic_validator.mjs.

findings.title: Listening Part 3 & 4 Full Audio Assembled by Raw Buffer Concatenation
findings.root_cause: regenerate_w33_listening_audio.mjs concatenates MP3 frame buffers via Buffer.concat(l3Bufs) without ffmpeg re-muxing or inter-turn silence headers.
findings.impact: While decodable by browser HTML5 Audio and Whisper, buffer concatenation can introduce minor timestamp discontinuities across legacy MP3 decoders.
findings.required_fix: Use ffmpeg or silence-padded MP3 concatenation utility.

findings.title: Day 2 Discovery Report & Day 4 Video Challenge Audio Independence
findings.root_cause: Student interactive speaking stations (Discovery Report, Story Writer P7, Video Challenge) record student mic audio rather than loading static pre-recorded MP3s.
findings.impact: Zero regression risk; these stations do not depend on static corpus MP3s.
